caption: The drawing depicts two wooden objects on a plain, light beige background. The object on the left is a goblet-shaped piece with a rounded bowl, a narrow neck, and a wider, rounded base, rendered in warm brown tones with natural wood grain patterns visible throughout the surface. The object on the right is a shallow, round bowl, viewed from above, featuring a similar brown coloring and wood grain texture. Inside the bowl, there is a grouping of small, scattered black dots concentrated near the center, and faint, irregular grayish marks around the inner base. Both objects are centered horizontally and are spaced apart, with the goblet on the left and the bowl on the right. In the bottom right corner, there are small, neatly written inscriptions in pencil.
title: Sand Shaker
